sourceText:
Spanish Enchiladas
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce
1 dozen corn tortillas
1 can Hormel chili without beans
1 1/2 pounds hamburger, browned
1/2 cup chopped onion
3 cups shredded cheddar cheese
1/2 cup picante sauce

Preparation

1 Brown hamburger and drain. Add remainder of ingredients (except cheese and tortillas) and simmer. Place sauce in corn tortilla; sprinkle with cheese and roll up, placing seam side down in bottom of glass baking dish. 2 Lay tortillas close together until dish is filled. Pour remaining sauce over top enchiladas and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until cheese melts good. Serve with Spanish rice and refried beans.
